notes: Design inferred as cross-sectional (the report calls it a pilot study with a convenience-sample survey). 'No significant differences' is stated twice, but no p-values, CIs or test are reported anywhere (only SPSS is named), so under brief rule C no unnamed test is recorded. If a test is read in, the groupwise entries would become omnibus tests.
view_issues: 'Significant' is used with no test, p-value or CI reported. Table 1 shows lifetime use 45% in boys vs 35% in girls (n=282 vs 342), a gap a standard chi-square would likely call significant, contradicting 'no significant differences in bidi use by sex'.
